homepage.aboutIntro_text: Shenzhen Minglang Packaging Products Co., Ltd. has been deeply rooted in the flexible packaging field for 20 years, with two major production bases: Xinglong Packaging and Huilida Packaging. We specialize in ODM/OEM services for fabric storage bags and gift packaging, serving e-commerce sellers and brands in the jewelry, beauty, 3C accessories, and gift industries worldwide.

about.title: About Us
about.company_parent: Shenzhen Minglang Packaging Products Co., Ltd.
about.company_parent_desc: Founded in 2006, Minglang Packaging is a comprehensive packaging enterprise integrating design, R&D, production, and sales, headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong Province.
about.company_subsidiary1: Shenzhen Xinglong Packaging Products Co., Ltd.
about.company_subsidiary1_desc: Xinglong Packaging focuses on the design and manufacturing of fabric storage bags, with advanced production equipment and an experienced technical team.
about.company_subsidiary2: Shenzhen Huilida Packaging Products Co., Ltd.
about.company_subsidiary2_desc: Huilida Packaging is dedicated to ODM/OEM services for gift packaging, providing high-quality customized packaging solutions for clients.
about.mission_text: Based on eco-friendly materials and centered on exquisite craftsmanship, we provide high-quality, green, and sustainable packaging solutions for global customers. We believe that good packaging is not only product protection but also brand value delivery.
